title: Text: DET Ben Fidelman ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Only thing I noticed was twins owner should be Jim Pohlad, not Carl
It was good you were at the parties. You and Jeff killed coverage, everyone else was like invisible all weekend
Shit, thanks. And thanks. It was fun. Good job to you as well
And you owe me for not mentioning the picture of Randy O’Neal
Lol, thankfully he laughed it off. Only hiccup of the weekend.
